adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, the new sync-path does `fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, { method: "POST", body: new URLSearchParams(...) })` and returns the raw `Response` without any `response.ok` validation or error handling. This can let non-2xx responses flow into token refresh code paths as if they were valid token payloads (or produce undefined token fields in callers that expect `.data`), and the lack of any timeout/abort means a hung sync endpoint can stall token refresh indefinitely. This behavior is introduced by the diff.
